key_insight: Tau-orthogonal (TO) closure reduces LES turbulence modeling in LBM to predicting a small set of integrated QoIs, enabling stable and accurate coarse simulations without high-dimensional SGS fields.
engineering_relevance: This offers a low-cost, interpretable alternative to neural subgrid models for practical large-eddy simulation, especially for wall-bounded turbulent flows.
method: Use macroscopic-velocity forcing in lattice Boltzmann LES
Track reference QoI trajectories with predictor-corrector training data generation
Fit lightweight linear regression with stochastic multivariate Gaussian residuals (TO-LRS) and use compact convolution kernels
evidence_signal: The method is stable and statistically accurate in 2D Kolmogorov flow, and in 3D turbulent channel flow it reproduces reference distributions and the DNS mean velocity profile at about 40x lower online cost than the high-fidelity simulation.
watch_item: The approach can show bounded high-frequency oscillations, and performance depends on the chosen QoIs and the need for an eddy-viscosity substrate in the 3D channel case.
paper_title: Reduced Subgrid-Scale Terms for Turbulence Simulations with the Lattice Boltzmann Method
